title: ネジが一本余る
mood: deadpan irritation that ends in a shrug
subject: finishing a flat-pack bookshelf alone and finding one screw left over on the floor
caption: Japanese math rock. Two clean electric guitars playing interlocking two-hand tapped lines and short stabbing riffs, a melodic electric bass tapping its own counter-lines, drums shifting between 7/8 and 4/4 with sudden full stops and accented fills, light overdrive kicked on for the chorus. Dry and close, a small room with the kit miked from the room, every instrument separated and the bass loud. Female voice, deadpan and talky in the verses, breaking into a shout at the chorus peaks, with short group harmonies from the band. 150 BPM, F# minor. Deadpan irritation that ends in a shrug. No four-on-the-floor, no synths, no autotune, no long reverb, no ballad section, no straight-eighth indie-rock strumming, no pop-punk power chords.
lyrics:
[Intro - tapped guitars in 7/8]

[Verse 1]
説明書は絵だけ 文字が一個もない
棚板四枚 六角レンチ一本
二時間かけて立てた 本も入れた
床に ネジが 一本 残ってる

[Pre-Chorus]
袋を見る 絵を見る
数は合ってる はずだった

[Chorus]
ネジが一本 余る
どこのネジか わかんない
揺らしても 揺れない
じゃあ お前は 何なの

[Verse 2]
もう一回 全部外すのは 嫌
漫画 四十冊 もう入れちゃった
ネジは小皿に置いて 見ないふり
夜中 棚が鳴った気がして 起きる

[Chorus]
ネジが一本 余る
どこのネジか わかんない
揺らしても 揺れない
今日から お前は お守り

[Bridge - drums stop, bass alone]
説明書 裏返したら
小さい字で 「予備 一本」

[Outro - full stop]
先に言ってよ
[Song ends abruptly]
